company.name: Metal
company.shortDescription: Metal is a data-driven platform that help founders identify, research, and connect with investors and manage fundraising workflows.
company.description: Metal's offers advanced intelligence and insights on venture investors, enabling founders to be super targeted in pursuing firms that are most likely to invest. For founders actively raising capital, the platform unlocks an advanced level of efficiency by showing optimal intro pathways to each investor and by offering a customisable investor CRM platform.

productsAndServices.description: A tool to identify investors that match a company's stage, sector, and geography using detailed filters and system recommendations.
productsAndServices.name: Investor Search Intelligence

productsAndServices.description: Analyzes historical investment patterns of investors to assess their relevance for a company's current fundraising stage.
productsAndServices.name: Investor Qualification via Empirical Precision

productsAndServices.description: Identifies venture-backed companies similar to a user's company to find investors who have previously invested in those companies.
productsAndServices.name: Similar Companies Algorithm

productsAndServices.description: Uses LinkedIn, Gmail, and other data sources to map warm introduction paths from a user's network to target investors.
productsAndServices.name: Intro Pathways Network Intelligence

productsAndServices.description: A CRM tool that provides real-time data and historical venture deal insights to guide founders through the fundraising process.
productsAndServices.name: Investor CRM with Real-Time Fundraising Guidance

productsAndServices.description: Identifies the core investment themes and sector focus of individual investors based on their historical venture investments.
productsAndServices.name: Investing Thesis Discovery

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $20,000,000 to $26,061,565, a 1.3x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 92 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 81 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Foundersuite, OpenVC, Visible.vc.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
